corporate_email_commits_in_upstream.open_question: Whether any claim attaches to work authored under a corporate email and then published under MIT in a public repository cannot be determined from the evidence available to this audit. Recorded as an open legal-review item; no finding made.
corporate_email_commits_in_upstream.note: The string 'Siemens' has never appeared in any blob of any commit of leo-dynamics.
corporate_email_commits_in_upstream.note_reachability: All seven commits reachable from upstream origin/main are ancestors of it. Verified with 'git merge-base --is-ancestor' for each of the seven.

derivation_assessment.method: Line-by-line comparison of the upstream Julia formulations against the corresponding leo-dynamics C++ implementations.

findings.upstream: a_mag = P * area * C_r * cos^2 / mass (single reflectivity coefficient, src/Gravity.jl)

findings.project: detect_apsides: radial-velocity zero crossing with linear interpolation (src/analysis/orbital.cpp)

derivation_assessment.conclusion: The three compared algorithms use different formulations, not equivalent source text. This is NOT a conclusion that no upstream material is retained: all40 altitude/density anchors from upstream Constants.jl are retained numerically after unit conversion. See numeric_table_evidence and independent review. No legal substantiality/title determination is made.
